events.title: UNKNOWN CONNECTION
texts: A stranger probed your uplink.
An unregistered relay pinged your node.
Someone is knocking on a port you never opened.

events.title: SYSTEM ALERT
texts: NEXUS integrity scan in progress.
Anomalous traffic spike detected on the grid.
A watchdog process woke up and looked around.

events.title: UNKNOWN USER DETECTED
texts: An unlisted user was seen near the NEXUS grid.
A ghost account flickered online for 0.3 seconds.
User ID 000 touched the network, then vanished.

events.title: DEAD CREDIT TRANSFER
texts: An abandoned account paid out.
A bounty cleared in your name.
A forgotten escrow released.

events.title: SIGNAL BREAKTHROUGH
texts: Patterns in the noise suddenly made sense.
You spotted a flaw in a routine you ran earlier.
A late insight pays off.

events.title: SYSTEM INSTABILITY
texts: The grid is wobbling. Traces are getting sharper.
A cascade of timeouts rolls through the network.
NEXUS routing tables are flapping.

events.title: DATA LEAK
texts: A leaked archive is circulating the back channels.
Someone dumped a database into the open. You grabbed a copy.
A careless admin posted credentials to a public board.

events.title: BLACKOUT
texts: A power fault knocked several nodes offline.
Sector failure: connections dropped across the grid.

events.title: SERVER MIGRATION
texts: A host is being migrated to new hardware. Its defences reset.
Scheduled migration: services will return shortly.

events.title: SECRET DATA FOUND
texts: A hidden cache surfaced in your scan buffers.
An encrypted drawer opened by itself.
A dormant account coughed up a bonus.
